scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof identifies only the strictly positive essential spectrum. Numerical checks are supplementary and do not certify an infinite theorem. Uninspected preprint text and broad related literature leave independent priority risk.
scientific_limitations: No determination of zero essential spectrum or isolated eigenvalues
The main motivating paper full text was inaccessible; novelty requires independent assessment
Only positive geometrically spaced atoms with fixed parameters are covered
title: A critical atomic Helson matrix has an exact theta-function essential band
